elements.requirement: Section 1225 applies if at any time it appears to the Secretary of State that a recognised supervisory body or a recognised qualifying body has failed to comply with an obligation imposed on it by or by virtue of this Part, excluding an obligation to pay a financial penalty under section 1225D.
